thread:
marta_cs: Quick draft — putting this here so ENG/SE/SRE can comment: customer-facing micro-runbook for activation lag + renewal-risk signals. covers prefill, lightweight caching, streaming fallbacks, and feedback capture. short bullets only for CSMs.

jamie_cs: love it. can you include the two quick checks we ask be run during handoff? (latency tail, recent error rate)

marta_cs: yes — added. here's the minimal checklist I had in mind:
- confirm last 24h token rate and 95p latency < target
- verify client prefill enabled and prefill TTL >= 30s
- ensure streaming endpoint enabled for demo flows
- collect 3 example prompts from the customer for eval

lee_sre: nit: prefill TTL depends on tenant traffic. maybe say "prefill TTL tuned to expected idle". also add how to toggle safe-fallback.

marta_cs: good point. updated text: "prefill TTL tuned to expected idle; default 30s. escalate to SRE if >2x tail latency vs baseline."

tony_se: for enablement, include the small snippet we hand customers to enable client-side streaming fallback. makes demos less brittle.

marta_cs: dropping snippet below (CS can paste into onboarding email):

```
# client-side streaming fallback (pseudocode)
if (streaming.available) {
  use('streaming');
} else if (prefill.ready) {
  use('prefill');
} else {
  use('standard'); // best-effort
}
```

ana_pm: (typo) my name is ana_pm :) Also, add a line about capturing voice-of-customer: short survey + ask for 1-2 critical flows that must not degrade.

marta_cs: fixed name, added VOC line: "send 3-question pulse after go-live: latency ok?, accuracy ok?, top 2 flows impacted?"

jamie_cs: for renewal-risk signals can we define thresholds that auto-tag accounts in Salesforce? e.g., repeated activation lag >3 incidents in 30d = RenewalRisk flag.

lee_sre: agree. also add immediate mitigations for SRE triage: bump prefill pool, enable extra batch workers, rollback quantization if recent change.

marta_cs: added mitigation steps and a short triage play: 1) gather logs + sample prompt 2) run local smoke on model variant 3) open SRE ticket with tag `cs-activation`

cs-bot: Reminder: paste runbook URL into ticket template -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs-activation-micro (auto-note) :bell:

tony_se: one more: include a quick paragraph for CSMs on when to escalate to SE vs SRE vs PM. keeps handoffs clean.

marta_cs: done — split by ownership. final ask: reviewers, please thumbs up if ready to publish to the shared playbooks folder. :eyes:

jamie_cs: :thumbsup:

lee_sre: :thumbsup: small wording ok

ana_pm: :thumbsup:

marta_cs: thanks team — I'll publish and add to the onboarding checklist.
